Definition: Otsem, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Otsem was a son of Jesse, named twice in the genealogy of Judah: once among the sons of Jesse, and once among the sons of Jerahmeel's line. He was the sixth son of Jesse, the brother of David, counted among the family of Bethlehem.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Otsem is one of the quiet sons of Jesse: named twice in the genealogy and nowhere else, and still written down.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
